headline: Clinton executive order sets rules meant to improve how the federal government handles civil lawsuits and writes legal rules.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government takes part in civil (non-criminal) court cases. It appears to give federal agencies guidelines meant to make civil lawsuits involving the government fairer, faster, or less costly. No summary was provided, so the exact requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would be expected to follow the order's guidelines when handling civil lawsuits.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses in civil court cases with the federal government
who_it_affects.how: How the government handles their cases may be shaped by the order's rules.
